text:
Sam P: dropping a lightweight check-in on the Alerting preview widget. Goal: make it crystal what will happen when an SLO breaches — who gets paged, whether suppressions apply, and what the preview timeline shows. Lina: first pass looks good. two concerns: 1) the threshold badge text is ambiguous (is that the threshold or current value?), 2) suppression indicator is too subtle. Omar: agree on threshold badge. suggestion: badge shows 'Threshold: 5% (5m)' or 'Current: 7%'. action-first helps scanning. Priya: suppression should read as a state, not an ornament. proposed: a small pill 'Suppressed Quiet window active' with a tooltip explaining why. if it's active, show a filled red/amber dot so it's obvious at glance. Sam P: good. also thinking about the channel preview row we currently show channel name + tiny icon. should we call out who will be paged vs who will just be notified? customers get confused. Lina: microcopy idea: 'On-call (pages): PagerPolicy Primary' and 'Notifies: #alerts-ops'. makes it explicit. Omar: accessibility note: screen readers need the action verb. instead of 'On-call', use 'Pages on-call' or 'Sends page to on-call'. for the notify line, 'Sends message to channel'. Priya: a11ybot chiming in: "Contrast check: quiet window pill currently 3.2:1. If pill conveys behavior, we require 4.5:1. Consider darker text or outline." Sam P: thanks A11yBot. decision: if suppression prevents paging we treat the label as important and bump contrast. Lina: UX question: for long policy names, do we truncate with ellipsis or wrap? wrapping breaks compact layout. truncate + reveal on hover/keyboard focus seems best. ensure full name accessible to screenreader via aria-describedby. Omar: code snippet for devs: ``` PagerPolicy: VeryLongPolicyName``` Priya: small copy tweak: avoid 'escalate' as a verb in the preview. customers ask "escalate to what?" Use explicit verbs: 'Pages', 'Sends message', 'Retries with'. Sam P: good call. also where do we surface suppression rationale? inline? tooltip? log? PM prefers a short inline reason for confidence (e.g., 'Muted during maintenance') and full details in the right-hand panel. Lina: inline reason should be human-friendly and short. limit to ~30 chars. use sentence case. example: 'Muted for scheduled maintenance'. Omar: last bit timeline scrubber in the preview currently shows colored bands for suppression windows and annotations for threshold breaches. accessibility: keyboard focus must land on each band with an aria-label like 'Suppressed from 10:00-14:00' or 'Breach at 13:05: 7.2%'. Priya: agree. add aria-live updates when user toggles suppression on/off so AT users hear the change. small example: ```
Suppression active: Muted for scheduled maintenance
``` Sam P: action items: Lina to update mock with action-first copy + contrast bump, Omar to add aria-describedby example to component doc, Priya to validate timeline focus states, Sam will add the inline suppression reason microcopy and push new PNG. I'll re-open thread once mocks are updated. A11yBot: uploaded accessibility checklist https://redwood-internal/a11y/checklists/alert-preview.json :white_check_mark: Sam P: thanks all will iterate and post updated designs later today. :rocket:
